result.description: A fictional 27-inch desktop display designed for general office, illustration, and content review workflows. The ArcDesk 27Q pairs a sharp QHD IPS panel with a clean matte chassis, wide viewing angles, and an adjustable stand for comfortable everyday use. It includes DisplayPort, HDMI, and USB-C input options, supports a 75 Hz refresh rate, and is intended as a versatile productivity monitor rather than a gaming or workstation graphics device.
